articles.title: Policy briefing: what a new national plan could mean for households
articles.deck: A sample explainer shows how a newsroom can connect policy coverage to everyday questions.
articles.author: victoria
articles.body:
This demonstration story illustrates a clear, sourced explainer format. Replace this sample copy with verified reporting before publication.

A strong article record includes its headline, deck, category, author reference, publication time, image metadata, tags and related coverage. Author information comes from a shared profile, so a profile update flows through every byline.

For a real newsroom, editors should add primary-source links and confirm all facts before publication.

articles.title: Markets watch: a practical guide to reading the week’s business signals
articles.deck: A demo finance story built to show category, author and related-article connections.
articles.author: tunde
articles.body:
This is clearly marked sample content. It demonstrates the structure for accessible financial coverage without inventing market figures or claims.

A production workflow should attach source material, check figures and label analysis separately from straight reporting.

articles.title: Screen culture: how local creators are finding new audiences
articles.deck: A sample entertainment feature with an individual byline and reusable author profile.
articles.author: amara
articles.body:
This sample feature has no fabricated quotations or claims about real people. Add interviews and verified context when replacing the demo copy.

The author profile can also list recurring opinion pieces, giving readers a route to more work by the same contributor.

articles.title: City services: a checklist for following local infrastructure updates
articles.deck: A practical metro template for clear public-interest reporting.
articles.author: victoria
articles.body:
Demo story. A published version should cite official records and clearly identify the locations and dates covered.

The article page reserves fields for image caption, credit, alt text, editor, updated time and related reporting.

articles.title: Global brief: making sense of a changing international agenda
articles.deck: A sample foreign-affairs story page for the Vickipedia News archive.
articles.author: tunde
articles.body:
This is a structural demonstration, not a report of actual events. A live story should include links to official documents and reliable sources.

Publication and update timestamps remain distinct so readers can see when information changed.

articles.title: Weekend sport: the questions shaping a season ahead

articles.author: victoria
articles.body: Demo preview. No real result, athlete quote or statistic is asserted. The article model can reference verified data and associated video when provided.

articles.title: Digital life: a simple guide to checking claims online
articles.deck: A technology explainer template built around practical reader questions.
articles.author: amara
articles.body: Demo explainer copy. In a real article, the newsroom should explain its verification method and link to authoritative guidance.

articles.title: Opinion: trust begins with showing readers how a story was reported
articles.deck: An example individual opinion piece, clearly distinct from reporting.
articles.author: amara
articles.body:
This sample opinion piece demonstrates a prominent contributor byline and author link. Replace with an authored argument and retain clear sourcing for factual claims.

Opinion belongs to its named author; it does not automatically represent the publication’s institutional voice.

articles.title: Newsroom notes: a guide to the Vickipedia Video format
articles.deck: Introducing a flexible home for short explainers and video news.
articles.author: victoria
articles.body:
A sample introduction to a multimedia format. A video record can use an uploaded file, a hosted platform embed or a placeholder until video is ready.

No media is auto-played. For launch, add captioning, transcript and rights-cleared thumbnail artwork.
